fields.statement: At 174b2970 ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run 'OpenPR' -count=1 -v: all five OpenPR tests pass, incl. TestShipOpenPRBodyRef. It opens a PR for a change set whose ref holds backticks, a newline and an @mention and checks the body sent to the fake gh has exactly one line Ref: `https://x.test/1 \x60a\x60 @mention\n# heading` (one inline code span, backticks as \x60, newline as \n, no line escapes the span), and that a change set without a ref gets no Ref: line. Read the diff: findShipTarget carries c.Open.Ref; prBodyRef returns empty for no ref and escapes backticks, CR/LF and other control runes before wrapping in one code span. gofmt and go vet clean.
